trigger: The registered S7.1 aggregate gate passed, but manual site-level inspection showed that task-failure events may be concentrated in one validation site.
claim_boundary: This is a transparently post-hoc robustness diagnostic triggered by inspection of the registered S7.1 result.
The diagnostic does not retroactively change the registered S7.1 aggregate decision.
The internal development-test and reserve signal values remain unread.
AUC and average precision are undefined for sites containing only one label class; such sites are reported but excluded from macro discrimination metrics.
Bootstrap resampling treats the validation site, not individual scenes, as the independent unit.
The diagnostic can block premature candidate freezing but cannot establish confirmatory model performance.
